nodes.name: Brave Web Search
nodes.notes: Uses an HTTP Header Auth credential. Header Name: X-Subscription-Token. Header Value: your Brave Search API key. Re-select your local credential after import.

nodes.name: Call Jina Reader Workflow
nodes.notes: After importing Jina Reader - Fetch URL, select that workflow here. The sub-workflow handles Redis rate limiting, wait/backoff, and Reader HTTP retries.

parameters.content:
## Brave credential
Use an **HTTP Header Auth** credential.

Header Name: `X-Subscription-Token`
Header Value: your Brave Search API key.

After import, open **Brave Web Search** and re-select your local credential if needed.

## Jina Reader sub-workflow
This workflow no longer calls Jina Reader directly. It calls **Jina Reader - Fetch URL** for every unique Brave result URL.

After import, open **Call Jina Reader Workflow** and select the imported standalone Reader workflow.

The Reader workflow handles Redis rate limiting, waits, retries, and error normalization.

json.query: n8n execute sub-workflow trigger input data
